blocking.claim: "Before restoration, the park's 199 recorded plant species included 25 invasive exotics and 34 rare or threatened natives; a 2022 marine survey off the same coast counted around 300 species, from algae to marine mammals."
blocking.problem: This margin note flatly asserts the 199-species count (and its 25/34 breakdown) as a "before restoration" figure. The underlying fact, F16, is written in the present tense with no before/after qualifier at all ("a área apresenta uma elevada diversidade florística, com 199 espécies registadas" — the area PRESENTS/HAS 199 recorded species), unlike F15 and F18, which the sheet explicitly marks as pre-intervention ("antes das intervenções de restauro ecológico...", "antes da intervenção..."). The page's own main text (environment.mdx) is careful to avoid this trap — it presents the 14-habitat/199-species/200-animal figures as general survey findings, not as an explicitly dated "before" baseline — but this margin note, appearing on the same page, states a specific temporal frame the source never attaches to this fact. A reader would take this as confirmation the invasive-species count is a historical pre-restoration number, when the source gives no such timing.
blocking.evidence: F16: "a área apresenta uma elevada diversidade florística, com 199 espécies registadas" (present tense, no before/after marker) — vs. F15: "antes das intervenções de restauro ecológico, apenas 3 se encontravam em bom estado de conservação" and F18: "antes da intervenção... ocupavam cerca de 63% da área" — both of which DO carry an explicit "before" marker that F16 lacks.
blocking.fix: Change to: "The park's 199 recorded plant species include 25 invasive exotics and 34 rare or threatened natives; a 2022 marine survey off the same coast counted around 300 species, from algae to marine mammals." (drops the unsupported "Before restoration" framing and tense).

advisory.where: environment.mdx, "The deeper history under the restoration" section, closing sentence
advisory.claim: "Both finds belong to the shared protected coastline the park now covers, not to Adraga's beach itself."
advisory.problem: The fact sheet's identity warning says to attribute the dinosaur footprints and Paleolithic tool sites to "the shared protected coastline" rather than to Adraga itself — it does not establish that the Parque Ecológico da Adraga e Praia Grande's own boundary literally covers the Praia Grande do Rodízio cliff face where the footprints sit (F48 is sourced independently from prehistoricportugal.com, not from the park's own cm-sintra.pt page, and never ties the footprint site to the park's footprint). "The park now covers" is a more specific territorial claim than the sheet supports; "the shared, UNESCO-protected coastline" would match the sourced framing without implying the ecological park's boundary specifically includes the footprint site.
advisory.evidence: identity.warnings: "...should be attributed to 'the shared protected coastline' rather than to Adraga itself" (no park-boundary claim); F48 (prehistoricportugal.com) makes no reference to the ecological park.
advisory.fix: Change to: "Both finds belong to the same protected stretch of coastline, not to Adraga's beach itself."
